nodes.label: Flux de clôture d'un BL livré
nodes.norm_label: flux de cloture d'un bl livre
nodes.rationale: Le chauffeur photographie le BL livré, les coordonnées GPS sont capturées automatiquement avec la position courante, puis tout est transmis au serveur avec le token d'authentification. Le serveur vérifie le token et que le BL appartient bien à un voyage du chauffeur connecté avant toute persistance, garantissant l'autorisation. La photo est sauvegardée dans un dossier dédié par voyage avec un nom unique pour éviter les conflits, et la position GPS est stockée pour savoir où le BL a été livré, puis le statut passe à 'Livré'.

nodes.label: Demande de transfert
nodes.rationale: Stored fields: référence (auto-generated), dépôt source et destination, DUM, transporteur, matricule, observation, créateur (connected user), date de création, statut initial.

nodes.label: Enregistrement de la demande
nodes.rationale: Persistence is wrapped in a database transaction; the new transfer request is created with initial status « Brouillon ».

nodes.label: Génération de la référence
nodes.rationale: Reference format is « DT » + sequential number or « DT » + year + counter; the number is auto-incremented based on existing requests (e.g. DT2500001).

nodes.label: Saisie du formulaire
nodes.rationale: Dépôt source and dépôt destination are mandatory; DUM, transporteur, matricule and observation are optional fields.

nodes.label: Soumission
nodes.rationale: The mobile app sends the form to the server together with the authentication token.

nodes.label: Vérifications
nodes.rationale: Server verifies the token, identifies the connected user, and ensures source and destination dépôts are provided; if missing, returns error « Dépôt source et destination requis » (alt fragment).

nodes.label: Filtrer les retours (Filter Bottom Sheet)
nodes.rationale: Modal bottom sheet overlays the returns list to let users narrow results without leaving the screen; kept minimal (two filters plus reset) because the return list only has driver and client as meaningful dimensions.

nodes.label: Returns Filtering by Driver and Client
nodes.norm_label: returns filtering by driver and client
nodes.rationale: Returns are tracked against a responsible driver (chauffeur) and a client, so filtering by exactly those two dimensions matches the two primary accountability axes of a return record.

nodes.label: Audit Metadata (Créé par / Date)
nodes.rationale: Traceability fields (creator SAADI BADREDDINE and creation timestamp) are grouped at the bottom as secondary, read-only information.

nodes.label: Dépôt Source/Destination Reference
nodes.rationale: Source and destination are shown as opaque IDs in the summary; human-readable depot names are deferred to the details view.

nodes.label: Icon Label-Value Detail Row
nodes.rationale: Consistent grid of leading orange icon + muted label + dark value makes dense attribute lists scannable on small screens.

nodes.label: Détails Action Button
nodes.rationale: Soft-tinted full-width CTA with eye icon delegates the complete record view to a separate screen, keeping the expanded card lightweight.

nodes.label: Expand/Collapse Chevron
nodes.rationale: Upward chevron communicates the card is currently expanded and can be collapsed back to its summary row.

nodes.label: Observation Field
nodes.rationale: Free-text observation column wraps across lines, indicating the detail list must accommodate multi-line values.

nodes.label: Status Badge (Reçu)
nodes.rationale: Pill-shaped badge surfaces lifecycle state (Reçu = received) at the top-right without competing with the primary identifier.

nodes.label: Transport Record (DT2026005)
nodes.rationale: Core domain entity of the card: an identified transport movement referenced by a human-readable key (DT2026005) and a transporteur name.

nodes.label: Expanded Transport Card (DT2026005)
nodes.rationale: Mobile UI pattern: a collapsed summary header that expands inline to reveal full record fields, avoiding a full-page navigation for quick inspection.

nodes.label: Lot Selection Mechanism
nodes.rationale: A modal bottom sheet overlays the request detail screen so users can multi-select lots without losing context; selected rows are outlined in orange, flagged with a checkmark, and the live count plus Enregistrer button are pinned to the bottom for a confirm-or-cancel flow.

nodes.norm_label: card header (depot #22, tdts, date, image count, collapse chevron)

nodes.label: Detail Field List (Contact, Telephone, Créé par, Date, Coordonnées, Commentaire)

nodes.norm_label: icon + label + value row layout pattern

nodes.label: Collapsible Card Pattern (Header Toggles Expanded Detail)
nodes.norm_label: collapsible card pattern (header toggles expanded detail)
nodes.rationale: The card presents a compact header (title, subtitle, date, image count) that expands to reveal full metadata, images, and actions. This keeps lists scannable while allowing on-demand detail without navigating away, at the cost of hidden information for collapsed rows.

nodes.label: DUM or Dossier Required Validation Rule
nodes.norm_label: dum or dossier required validation rule
nodes.rationale: DUM and dossier are individually optional, but at least one must be provided. This loosens the form so a report can be identified by either a DUM reference or a folder, while still guaranteeing the report is attributable to something.
